title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tanner Ingle signs with Rams' active roster
items.desc: The Rams signed S Tanner Ingle from the practice squad to the active roster.
items.impact: Ingle will add depth in the secondary for the Rams with Kam Kinchens battling a hamstring injury.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Juwan Johnson (illness) off injury report Week 2
items.desc: Juwan Johnson is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Ravens.
items.impact: Johnson was a late addition to the injury report this week with an illness. He'll be on the TE1/TE2 radar for fantasy managers this week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Cameron Jordan (hamstring) off injury report Week 2
items.desc: Cameron Jordan is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Ravens.
items.impact: Jordan returned to a full practice on Friday. He'll be a full-go on Sunday against Baltimore.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Chamarri Conner (knee) misses practice Friday
items.desc: Chamarri Conner did not practice on Friday.
items.impact: Conner will most likely be listed as out for Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Josh Simmons (back) misses practice Friday
items.desc: Josh Simmons did not practice on Friday.
items.impact: Chiefs head coach Andy Reid said Simmons will most likely be listed as out for Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Alvin Kamara (knee) off injury report for Week 2
items.desc: Alvin Kamara is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Ravens.
items.impact: Kamara will be good to go for his season debut. He should be in a third down/passing down role in the Saints backfield behind Travis Etienne.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Chase Young (calf) listed questionable for Week 2
items.desc: Chase Young has been listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Ravens.
items.impact: Young was able to practice on Friday after he was a late addition to the injury report on Thursday. He should be on the favorable side of questionable, but he'll still need to be monitored on Sunday ahead of kickoff.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Chris Olave (hamstring) listed questionable for Week 2
items.desc: Chris Olave has been listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Ravens.
items.impact: Olave was able to practice on Friday after he was a late addition to the injury report on Thursday. He should be on the favorable side of questionable, but he'll still need to be monitored on Sunday ahead of kickoff.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ronnie Harrison Jr. (hamstring) ruled out Week 2
items.desc: Ronnie Harrison Jr. has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the 49ers.
items.impact: Harrison was unable to practice all week due to a hamstring injury. He will be sidelined on Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Chop Robinson (concussion) ruled out Week 2
items.desc: Chop Robinson has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the 49ers.
items.impact: Robinson remains in the concussion protocol. He'll miss at least one game on Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Anthony Richardson Sr. (groin) expected to be available Week 2
items.desc: Anthony Richardson Sr. is expected to be available for Sunday's game against the Chiefs.
items.impact: Richardson returned to practice on Thursday. He should remain the backup to Daniel Jones.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ashton Dulin (ankle) ruled out for Week 2
items.desc: Ashton Dulin has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Chiefs.
items.impact: Dulin did not practice this week. He is characterized as week-to-week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Teven Jenkins (back) ruled out Week 2
items.desc: Teven Jenkins has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Buccaneers.
items.impact: Jenkins will miss a second straight game to begin the season. He'll hope to be ready to go for his season debut in Week 3.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tyson Campbell (ankle) listed questionable for Week 2
items.desc: Tyson Campbell has been listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Buccaneers.
items.impact: Campbell was a late addition to the injury report on Thursday. His status will need to be monitored closer to kickoff on Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jack Strand to serve as backup QB for Falcons in Week 2
items.desc: Falcons head coach Kevin Stefanski said Jack Strand will be the backup quarterback again on Sunday against the Panthers.
items.impact: It will be Cooper Rush drawing another start with Michael Penix Jr. ruled out and Tua Tagovailoa listed as doubtful.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Billy Bowman Jr. (Achilles) ruled out for Week 2
items.desc: Billy Bowman Jr. has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Panthers.
items.impact: Bowman was able to practice in full on Wednesday. He could be good to go as early as next week for the Falcons.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tua Tagovailoa (oblique) listed doubtful for Week 2
items.desc: Tua Tagovailoa has been listed as doubtful for Sunday's game against the Panthers.
items.impact: Tagovailoa is likely to miss a second straight game to begin the season. With Michael Penix Jr. ruled out, it is expected to be Cooper Rush starting for the Falcons again on Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Michael Penix Jr. (knee) ruled out for Week 2
items.desc: Michael Penix Jr. has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Panthers.
items.impact: Penix has been ruled out for a second straight game to begin the season. Tua Tagovailoa is listed as doubtful, leaving Cooper Rush as the starter again for Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jalen Coker (ankle) logs full practice Friday
items.desc: Panthers head coach Dave Canales said Jalen Coker was a full participant in practice on Friday.
items.impact: Coker began the week in a precautionary boot after he injured his ankle last Sunday against the Bears. He'll remain an upside WR3/flex play for fantasy managers heading into Week 2.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Carlton Davis III (neck) expected to be listed as questionable for Week 2
items.desc: Patriots head coach Mike Vrabel said Carlton Davis III will be listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Steelers.
items.impact: "Don't assume," Vrabel said when asked about Davis being ruled out. "He'll be questionable... If the designation changes we'll notify everybody."

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Lukas Van Ness (concussion) practices Friday
items.desc: Lukas Van Ness was seen practicing on Friday.
items.impact: Van Ness remains in concussion protocol. He remains up in the air for Week 2 against the Jets.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Brock Bowers (knee) back at practice Friday
items.desc: Brock Bowers was seen back at practice on Friday.
items.impact: Bowers return on Friday gives him a chance to play on Sunday against the Chargers. His status will need to be monitored when the official injury report is released.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Frankie Luvu (groin) ruled out for Week 2
items.desc: Frankie Luvu (groin) has been ruled out for Week 2 for the Washington Commanders against the Dallas Cowboys according to John Keim.
items.impact: Luvu will be sidelined for head coach Dan Quinn after being unable to practice in any capacity throughout the week, leaving the Washington linebacker corps without an impactful option against the Cowboys Sunday.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Chig Okonkwo (hamstring) ruled out for Week 2
items.desc: Chig Okonkwo (hamstring) has been ruled out for Week 2 for the Washington Commanders against the Dallas Cowboys according to John Keim.
items.impact: Okonkwo has been unable to practice throughout the week for head coach Dan Quinn and will not suit up against the Cowboys. Ben Sinnott and John Bates will receive increased snaps for the Commanders in Week 2.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Joe Burrow (back) cleared for Week 2
items.desc: Joe Burrow (back) logged a full practice session Friday and will start at quarterback for the Cincinnati Bengals against the Houston Texans in Week 2.
items.impact: Burrow was able to increase his practice activity as the week progressed and is good to go according to head coach Zac Taylor. The quarterback faces a tough Houston defense looking to put a difficult Week 1 loss to the Buffalo Bills in the rearview mirror.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Cooper Rush (back) expected to start behind center in Week 2
items.desc: Cooper Rush (back) is expected to start at quarterback for the Atlanta Falcons in Week 2 according to Ian Rapoport.
items.impact: Rush continues to fight through a back issue that popped up for head coach Kevin Stefanski, but barring any setbacks is poised to start behind center with Tua Tagovailoa (oblique) and Michael Penix Jr. (knee) still sidelined. The quarterback underwhelmed in a Week 1 loss to the Pittsburgh Steelers and should not be considered starter-worthy against the Carolina Panthers Sunday.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Zay Flowers (hamstring) returns to practice Friday
items.desc: Zay Flowers (hamstring) returned to practice Friday for the Baltimore Ravens according to Jamison Hensley.
items.impact: Flowers was able to log his first practice session of the week for head coach Jesse Minter, taking a step in the right direction in hopes of suiting up for Week 2. If the wideout is unable to receive final clearance, Rashod Bateman would slide into a No. 1 wideout role against the New Orleans Saints Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Alec Pierce (heel) seen practicing Friday
items.desc: Alec Pierce was seen practicing on Friday.
items.impact: Pierce did not practice on Thursday. His return on Friday gives him a good chance to be good to go for Sunday's game against the Chiefs.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Cedric Gray remains in concussion protocol
items.desc: Titans head coach Robert Saleh said Cedric Gray has pretty much done everything necessary to be cleared but hasn't been yet.
items.impact: Gray practiced in full again on Friday. He could be cleared by Saturday from the concussion protocol.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Cor'Dale Flott will not practice Friday, expected to play Sunday
items.desc: Titans head coach Robert Saleh said Cor'Dale Flott will not practice on Friday, but he's still expected to play on Sunday against the Eagles.
items.impact: Flott will not practice due to tightness. His status will still be worth monitoring on the official injury report.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: John Simpson (groin) seen practicing Friday
items.desc: John Simpson was seen at the start of practice on Friday.
items.impact: Simpson missed the last two days of practice with groin injury. His status will need to be monitored on the official injury report.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Nico Collins (hamstring) not seen practicing Friday
items.desc: Nico Collins was not seen at the start of practice on Friday.
items.impact: Collins will likely be ruled out when the injury report is officially released.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Aaron Banks (knee) uncertain for Week 2
items.desc: Packers head coach Matt LaFleur said Aaron Banks had a good practice on Thursday in pads but still isn't ready to say he'll play Sunday.
items.impact: Banks will be worth monitoring when the official injury report is released.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Bobby Brown III (back) not practicing Friday
items.desc: Bobby Brown III was not seen practicing on Friday.
items.impact: Brown missed practice all week. He'll likely be ruled out for Week 2 when the injury report is released later in the afternoon.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: B.J. Hill (achilles) not in uniform at Friday's practice
items.desc: B.J. Hill (achilles) did not dress for Friday's practice session.
items.impact: Hill was on the sidelines with a noticeable limp Friday morning. The veteran defensive lineman seems like a long shot for Sunday's game.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Javon Kinlaw (back) returns to practice Friday
items.desc: Javon Kinlaw was back practicing on Friday.
items.impact: Kinlaw did not practice on Thursday. He should be good to go for Sunday's game against the Cowboys.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Samaje Perine (illness) on the sidelines Friday
items.desc: Samaje Perine (illness) was on the sideline at the start of Friday's practice session.
items.impact: Perine has missed Thursday's practice as well due to an illness. The veteran back was a significant part of the Bengals' offense in Week 1, rushing for 20 yards on five carries and grabbing three passes for 30 yards. Perine still has a couple of days to get ready for Sunday's matchup with the Texans.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jason Sanders to remain Jets kicker in Week 2
items.desc: Jets head coach Aaron Glenn confirmed that Jason Sanders will kick for the team in Week 2 against the Packers.
items.impact: Sanders connected on 3-of-4 field goals and 2-of-2 extra points in the Jets Week 1 win over the Titans.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Michael Pittman Jr. (foot) not seen practicing Friday
items.desc: Michael Pittman Jr. was not seen to start practice on Friday.
items.impact: Pittman did not practice on Thursday. His status is uncertain for Sunday's game against the Patriots.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kyler Murray progressing through concussion protocol
items.desc: Kyler Murray continues to progress through concussion protocol.
items.impact: Graziano notes that Murray did more in practice on Thursday than Wednesday. Once he is cleared, the Vikings will decide whether to start him on Sunday or play it safe by holding him out a week.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Darnell Washington (personal) back at practice Friday
items.desc: Darnell Washington (personal) returned to practice on Friday.
items.impact: Washington missed Wednesday's and Thursday's practice session for personal reasons, but the big TE was back Friday. Washington secured both of his targets for 18 yards in Week 1's win over the Falcons.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: TreVeyon Henderson (ankle) ready for season debut
items.desc: TreVeyon Henderson (ankle) has been practicing in full this week and will be ready for Sunday's game.
items.impact: Henderson was unable to go in Week 1, leaving the bulk of the backfield load to veteran Rhamondre Stevenson. Henderson is in his second NFL season after totaling over 1,100 yards of offense and 10 touchdowns across 17 regular-season games as a rookie.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: D'Angelo Ponds (calf) to debut Sunday
items.desc: D'Angelo Ponds (calf) will play Sunday against the Packers.
items.impact: A second-round pick pick in this year's NFL Draft, Ponds was forced to put off his debut for a week due to a calf injury. The former Indiana Hoosier will be ready to take the field for the Jets in Week 2.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Will McDonald IV (ankle) good to go for Week 2
items.desc: Will McDonald IV (ankle) is expected to be ready for Sunday's game against the Packers.
items.impact: McDonald popped up on Thursday's injury report with an ankle issue, but the fourth-year pass rusher will be ready to go Sunday, according to head coach Aaron Glenn. McDonald picked up his first sack of the season in Week 1.
